source_admission.interpretation_guard: A visible-object count near nominal Sun depressions 6–8 degrees is an original human qualitative observation, but neither an identified star's first-seeing timestamp nor model timing error. Do not fit, score, forecast, pool as independent holdout, or extrapolate to 10.5–16 degrees. Treat ~ depths as author's narrative thresholds only; do not manufacture time or precision.
source_admission.preoutcome_guard: Source was examined with outcomes visible; not prospectively preregistered and not to be recast as result-blind independent validation.
